journey.title: Moving data
journey.purpose: Export a complete backup or printouts from Settings › Data & exports, then stage an import, review it, and restore with a checkpoint — never mutating live data before confirmation.

steps.intent: Export a complete backup and see what it includes and omits.
Stage an import and review counts, duplicates, and conflicts.
Confirm Restore everything after reviewing its impact and checkpoint.

claims.statement: Parsing and preview never change live data, and a failed restore leaves the previous workspace intact.
